name: Shadow of a Doubt
body:
Shadow of a Doubt CR 2

XP 600
NE Small outsider (extraplanar, evil)
Init +4; Senses see in darkness; Perception +4
Aura aura of doubt (20 ft., DC 12)

OFFENSE

AC 15, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+4 natural, +1 size)
hp 11 (2d10)
Fort +3, Ref +3, Will +0
Immune mind-affecting; Resist cold 5, electricity 5; SR 8

OFFENSE

Speed fly 60 ft. (perfect)
Ranged 2 shadow rays +3 ranged touch (1d6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 3th; concentration +4)

At will–darkness, lesser crushing despair, greater teleport (self plus 50 lbs. of objects only)

STATISTICS

Str 1, Dex 11, Con 10, Int 6, Wis 11, Cha 12
Base Attack +2; CMB -4; CMD 6
Feats Improved Initiative
Skills Bluff +6, Fly +14, Knowledge (planes) +3, Perception +4, Sense Motive +5
Languages Common, Abyssal, Aklo
SQ shadowy form

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura of Doubt (Su)

A shadow of a doubt has an aura that dims the area and causes unease in those around them. This lowers the light level by 1 level within 20 feet. This dimming is equivalent to a 1st level spell for the purposes of superseding light spells. Additionally, anytime a creature enters the aura they must make a Will save (DC 12, the save DC is charisma-based) or have the doubting condition until they leave the aura and for 1d4 rounds thereafter. Once a creature has been affected by the aura, they are immune to its effects for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting, despair condition.

Shadow Rays (Su)

A shadow of a doubt can shadowy rays to damage foes. These dark rays have a maximum range of 30 feet. This attack overcomes damage reduction of any type.

Shadowy Form (Su)

In any illumination other than bright light, a shadow of a doubt blends into the shadows, giving it concealment (20% miss chance). In darkness it gains total concealment (50% miss chance). This miss chance applies even if the attacker has darkvision, though creatures with see in darkness are not affected.

ECOLOGY

Environment the shadow plane or any evil-aligned plane
Organization solitary, pair, or despair (3-6)
Treasure incidental

This dark mote looms in a dim space and leaves you with a sense of unease.

Shadows of a doubt are very minor shadowy outsiders that wander dark places spreading doubt and fear.

Occasionally, they are bound to evil mortals to serve as familiars, acting as a tool to cow their master’s enemies.

A shadow of a doubt appears and a spherical mote of darkness, the size of a cannon ball, though it is largely insubstantial. It is impossible to see in darkness and is only revealed when bright light is forced upon it.

A shadow of a doubt is formed from the concentrated despair and hopelessness pulled from other planes into the shadow plane. Their consciousness is pulled from many people both alive and dead and as such does not have a true personality of its own.

Familiar

A 7th-level evil-aligned spellcaster with the Improved Familiar feat can select a shadow of a doubt as a familiar.
